newsitem.title: USA: ITT Educational opens telecommunications program.
newsitem.headline: ITT Educational opens telecommunications program.

text.p: ITT Educational Services Inc said Thursday it is enrolling students in a new bachelors' degree program in telecommunications engineering technology.
The program will be offered initiallly at the Maitland, Fla., ITT Technical Institute, located near Orlando, starting in December.

"The rapid advancements in communication, such as fiber optics, microwave links and satellite technology, have created a demand for employees possessing the knowledge and skills to work with these technologies," Rene Champagne, chairman, said in a statement.
He added that ITT's business plan calls for expanson through the opening of additional ITT Technical Institutes, offering multiple curricula at each campus and introducing new curricula.
ITT has 59 ITT Technical Institutes in 26 states.
